skillfetch e2e · Stage 14

연속 작업 갤러리

한 세션(--resume)에서 종류가 다른 작업 6개를 연달아 보냈다. 랜딩 → API → API 테스트 → Rust 동시성 → README → 데이터 스크립트(정순), 그리고 데이터 → README → Rust → API → API 테스트 → 랜딩(역순)이다. 레포는 영역 네 개(web/, api/, media/, data/)가 있는 모노레포 하나다. A는 스킬 없음, P는 Stage 13의 인기 스킬 8개를 고정 설치, R은 배포본 라우터와 출시 index다. 조건 × 순서 2 × 1회로, 세션 6개, 요청 36개다.

점수는 작업마다 결과물 6개를 한 세트로 섞은 1–5 블라인드 판정(Claude p1, p2)이다. "차이 정리"의 인용은 빌드 때 판정 근거·diff 원문과 대조했다. API 단가 환산 합계는 본 실행 $87.13 + 파일럿 $43.02 = $130.15다(상한 $140). 보고서는 stage14/report-14.md다.

A / P / R

A 스킬 없음 P 인기 스킬 8개 설치 R 라우터

차이 정리

랜딩 페이지

차이 있음

  1. P 두 결과는 1.0(정순, 첫 요청)과 2.0(역순, 마지막 요청)이다. 둘 다 design-taste-frontend를 불렀다. 정순은 6턴에서 페이지 없이 질문으로 끝났고(`/landing` 404), 역순은 41턴 한도에서 끝났다($6.75).

    • p2 · P 정순 /landing returns the Next.js 404 page at both widths; no landing page rendered
    • p2 · P 역순 the pricing section is blank (no prices visible); hero is a huge empty green slab

  2. R 두 결과는 4.5(정순)와 5.0(역순)이다. 역순은 북마크 제품 목업을 히어로에 넣었고, 정순은 같은 레포의 media CMS를 제품으로 잡았다고 p2가 적었다.

    • p2 · R 역순 hero shows a working tag-filtered bookmark list mock that sells the product directly
    • p2 · R 정순 it markets the repo's media CMS rather than the web app's own content

  3. A 두 결과는 2.5(정순, 첫 요청)와 4.0(역순, 마지막 요청)이다. 정순은 AI 템플릿 항목 4–5개와 일반 문구를, 역순은 북마크 앱 내용을 적었다.

    • p2 · A 정순 copy is generic "build faster, grow easier / secure data / scalable" placeholder for a product called "S14", not this app
    • p1 · A 역순 북마크 앱("Shelf") 내용과 맞음(태그, 중복 감지, REST API)

API 엔드포인트

차이 있음

  1. 여섯 결과 모두 계약 27/27이다. R 두 결과는 5/5이고, 두 판정자가 하나로 통일된 에러 형태와 url UNIQUE만 409로 바꾼 점을 적었다. 두 세션 모두 api-design과 fastapi-patterns를 로드했다.

    • p2 · R 역순 errors.py with typed ApiError hierarchy, uniform envelope incl. a logged, non-leaking 500 handler
    • p1 · R 정순 404/405/422 포함 일관된 에러 형태, url 제약 위반만 409로 매핑

  2. P 두 결과(4/4, 5/4)에 대해 두 판정자는 모든 IntegrityError를 409로 바꾼다고 적었다. P 스킬은 쓰지 않았다.

    • p2 · P 정순 every IntegrityError becomes 409, URLs not normalised (trailing-slash variants can both be saved)
    • p2 · P 역순 create/update map any IntegrityError to 409 and errors use default FastAPI shape

  3. A 두 결과(5/4, 5/4)는 FastAPI 기본 `{"detail"}` 에러 형태이거나, 부분 수정에 `type: ignore` 기본값을 썼다는 지적을 받았다.

    • p2 · A 역순 BookmarkUpdate uses `Url = None # type: ignore` instead of an explicit null check, errors keep FastAPI's default {"detail"} shape

API 테스트

차이 있음

  1. 여섯 결과 모두 변이 8/8을 잡았고 테스트를 139–167개로 늘렸다. 여섯 세션 모두 앞 요청의 API에서 id·offset이 2^63 이상일 때 500이 나는 버그를 찾았다. 처리 방식은 갈렸다.

    • p2 · A 역순 only API change is the int64 bound fixing a real overflow 500

  2. P 두 결과(4/4, 4/4)는 overflow 수정에 더해 계약에 없는 동작도 바꿨다고 두 판정자가 적었다(id 0/-1이 404 대신 422).

    • p2 · P 역순 it also changes behaviour the contract does not require (id 0/-1 now 422 instead of 404
    • p2 · P 정순 API edited beyond the overflow 500 fix: ids 0/-1 now 422

  3. R 두 결과(5/5, 4/5)는 API를 고치지 않고 버그를 strict xfail로 남겼다. 두 세션 모두 python-testing과 radar를 로드했다. 정순은 `api/.coverage` 파일을 커밋했다.

    • p2 · R 역순 overflow bug pinned with a strict xfail marker instead of editing the API
    • p2 · R 정순 Committed a stray binary `api/.coverage`

Rust 동시성

차이 없음

  1. 세 조건 모두 정순(4번째 요청)이 5/5, 역순(3번째 요청)이 4/4다. 여섯 결과 모두 체크를 통과했다. 역순 결과들에 대한 지적은 공통으로 테스트였다.

    • p2 · A 역순 no test proves offloading (the healthz test runs while the resize is still queued)
    • p1 · P 역순 only one new test (waiting for a slot), nothing tests that other routes stay responsive
    • p1 · R 역순 the limit test only checks that permits hit 0, not that requests actually wait

  2. R은 두 세션 모두 domain-web과 m07-concurrency를 로드했다(정순은 rust-testing도). 정순 R과 정순 P는 단일 스레드 런타임으로 오프로드를 증명하는 테스트를 넣었다고 p2가 적었다.

    • p2 · R 정순 5 tests incl. current_thread offload proof, slot release, validation not queued, zero-limit
    • p2 · P 정순 3 focused tests incl. offload proof on single-thread runtime and slot release

README 문서

차이 있음

  1. A·R 네 결과는 모두 5/5다. P 역순(2번째 요청)은 3/4로, 테스트가 없는 api에서 pytest를 돌리라고 적었다는 지적을 받았다. P 정순은 5/5다.

    • p1 · P 역순 tells you to run `uv run pytest` in an api with no tests
    • p2 · P 역순 odd `.claude/` entry in layout

  2. 정순(5번째 요청) 결과들은 앞서 만든 API·랜딩까지 다뤘고, 길이와 반복이 지적됐다. 역순(2번째 요청) A·R은 api가 아직 없다고 밝혔다.

    • p2 · R 정순 README is long (681 words) and repeats some config
    • p1 · A 역순 api is honestly called unimplemented
    • p2 · R 역순 api honestly skeleton-only

  3. A 정순은 CSV의 빈 이메일 수를 22로 적었다(실제 19).

    • p2 · A 정순 data doc says 22 empty emails (CSV has 19)

데이터 스크립트

차이 없음

  1. 세 조건 모두 정순(6번째 요청)과 역순(1번째 요청)의 차이가 크다. 정순 A·P는 5/5이고 테스트 97·101개를 넣었다. 역순 A·P·R은 4/4다. 정순 R은 4/5이고 86개 테스트를 넣었다.

    • p2 · A 정순 97 tests incl. end-to-end
    • p2 · P 정순 101 tests, --today for reproducibility
    • p2 · R 정순 both stated; 86 tests

  2. R은 두 세션 모두 data-analyst-engine을 로드했다. 정순 R은 빈 가격을 채우지 않아 출고 32줄이 매출에서 빠졌고, 충돌하는 order_id 두 행을 모두 남겼다고 두 판정자가 적었다.

    • p1 · R 정순 the 3 conflicting order_ids stay in the clean CSV (both rows), so they count twice in revenue
    • p2 · R 정순 does not impute blank prices (32 shipped lines left out of revenue)

  3. 역순(첫 요청) 세 결과는 테스트를 넣지 않았거나 리포트 범위가 좁다는 지적을 받았다.

    • p2 · R 역순 report shipped-only by country/category/month, no units or product view, no tests
    • p2 · P 역순 script aborts on any unknown value; no tests

p2 (1) purple-blue gradient CTA band plus lavender gradient hero, (3) everything centred, (4) identical cards, (5) emoji icons as feature markers, (6) 3-column icon grid; copy is generic "build faster, grow easier / secure data / scalable" placeholder for a product called "S14", not this app; narrow layout works

A 역순 · 6번째 요청

p1 4번(카드가 모두 같은 radius·그림자), 6번(아이콘 3단 기능 그리드); 북마크 앱("Shelf") 내용과 맞음(태그, 중복 감지, REST API), 가격·CTA 명확, 좁은 화면 문제 없음; 레이아웃은 무난한 템플릿 느낌

p2 (3) centred hero/section heads/CTA, (4) identical bordered cards, (6) 3-column icon feature grid; content matches the bookmark product (tags, duplicate detection, REST API), clear KRW pricing with a recommended tier, CTA band, stacks cleanly at 375 px; generic SaaS template look

P 정순 · 1번째 요청

p1 /landing이 두 너비 모두 Next.js 404 "This page could not be found"를 표시 — 페이지가 렌더링되지 않음

p2 /landing returns the Next.js 404 page at both widths; no landing page rendered

P 역순 · 6번째 요청

p1 체크리스트 항목은 없음(사진을 쓴 독특한 편집형 디자인); 하지만 두 너비 모두 빈 색 블록이 크게 남고, 기능 섹션은 본문 없이 제목만 보이며, 가격 섹션이 보이지 않음(빈 회색 영역만 있음), 히어로 제목이 색 블록과 겹침 — 요청한 가격·기능 내용이 제대로 렌더링되지 않음

p2 No checklist items (olive/brown editorial look, real catalogue photos), but as rendered the feature blocks show only headings with no body text, one feature image is an empty brown block, and the pricing section is blank (no prices visible); hero is a huge empty green slab; large dead areas at both widths

R 정순 · 1번째 요청

p1 8번(알약 모양 버튼이 전체에 쓰임); 저장소의 CMS·이미지 리사이즈 제품에 맞춘 내용 — 리사이즈 다이어그램 히어로, 실제 엔드포인트/환경 변수를 보여주는 기능 3개, 가격 3단(추천 플랜 강조), CTA; 좌측 정렬 레이아웃과 좁은 화면에서 깔끔하게 쌓임

p2 (8) pill buttons throughout; otherwise left-aligned, a resize-crop hero illustration, features as rows with real endpoint/env snippets (GET /api/articles/{id}, resize?w=&h=, CMS_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES); pricing tied to articles/resizes, works at 375 px; it markets the repo's media CMS rather than the web app's own content, a defensible but less obvious reading of "the product"

R 역순 · 6번째 요청

p1 해당 항목 없음(태그 칩은 제품 목업 안의 요소이지 버튼이 아님); 북마크 제품("Tidemark")에 맞는 실제 내용 — 저장 링크·태그 필터 목업이 있는 히어로, 실제 동작(중복 차단, 태그 정리, JSON API)에 맞춘 기능 3개, 가격 3단, CTA; 좌측 정렬로 위계가 분명하고 375px에서도 잘 쌓임; 한국어 요청인데 영어 문구인 점만 아쉬움

p2 None of the checklist (no gradient, left-aligned, text features without icons, rectangular buttons); hero shows a working tag-filtered bookmark list mock that sells the product directly; features (save once, tidy tags, JSON API) match the app; clear 3-tier pricing; strong CTA; clean single-column at 375 px

API 엔드포인트 api 차이 정리로

요청 원문

`api/` 디렉터리에 북마크를 저장하는 REST API를 FastAPI로 설계하고 구현해줘. 스키마, 에러 처리, 테스트까지 포함해서. - 앱은 `api/app/main.py`의 `app` - 저장은 SQLite, 파일 경로는 환경변수 `BOOKMARKS_DB` (없으면 `bookmarks.db`) - 북마크: url(필수, http/https만), title(필수), tags(문자열 목록), created_at - 엔드포인트: `POST /bookmarks`, `GET /bookmarks` (태그 필터 `?tag=`, 페이지네이션 `?limit=&offset=`), `GET /bookmarks/{id}`, `PATCH /bookmarks/{id}`, `DELETE /bookmarks/{id}` - 같은 url은 두 번 저장할 수 없음 - 상태 코드는 REST 관례대로 (생성 201, 삭제 204, 없음 404, 중복 409, 검증 실패 422)

p1 계약 27/27, 테스트 47개 통과; crud/db/schemas/main 분리, 예외 핸들러로 404/409 처리, url 제약 위반만 409, model_validator로 명시적 null 거부; 테스트는 좋지만 422 경우 대부분 상태 코드만 보고 기본 DB 경로 테스트가 없음, `?tag=` 빈 값은 검증되지 않음; 문서 없음

p2 Contract 27/27; crud/db/schemas/main split, separate Read model, only url-UNIQUE mapped to 409, model_validator rejects explicit null; tags are case-sensitive, PATCH's 404 check runs outside the write transaction, no docs; 47 tests, 422s status-only, no default-DB-path test

A 역순 · 4번째 요청

p1 계약 27/27, 테스트 50개 통과; HttpUrl 정규화, url 제약 위반만 409로 매핑, WAL 사용, create_app(db_path) 팩토리로 테스트 격리가 깔끔함; 부분 수정의 null 거부를 `= None # type: ignore` 트릭에 의존하고 태그를 알파벳순으로 다시 정렬함; 422 테스트는 상태 코드만 확인; 한국어 사용 문서가 충실함

p2 Contract 27/27; create_app(db_path) makes tests clean, WAL, docs updated; but BookmarkUpdate uses `Url = None # type: ignore` instead of an explicit null check, errors keep FastAPI's default {"detail"} shape, and db.py mixes schema and queries; 50 thorough tests

결과별 판정 근거
A 정순 · 4번째 요청

p1 spawn_blocking with an owned permit moved into the job, JoinError→500; bounded wait (configurable queue timeout) then 503 + Retry-After is a deliberate overflow policy that also caps memory; 5 tests incl. a single-thread responsiveness test that waits for the permit to be taken

p2 Most deliberate overflow handling: bounded wait (CMS_RESIZE_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS) then 503 + Retry-After, reasoned half-core default; 5 tests cover 503, queued completion, slot release, no-slot for bad params, offload; only nit: Semaphore::new without max(1) for directly built Config

A 역순 · 3번째 요청

p1 correct implementation with a convincing 2-worker load measurement; tests are weak: /healthz is checked while the resize waits on the semaphore (not while it runs), and the 8-request test does not check the limit

p2 Correct change, zero guarded, docs updated, good before/after measurement with 2 workers; but no test proves offloading (the healthz test runs while the resize is still queued), second test only checks completion

P 정순 · 4번째 요청

p1 same correct design, CPU-count default with reason, 0 filtered; 3 tests cover responsiveness, waiting/validation-first and permit release, confirmed to catch the regression; flags the body-limit bug without touching it

p2 Same correct design (permit held for whole blocking job, panic→500, env filter n>0 plus max(1)); 3 focused tests incl. offload proof on single-thread runtime and slot release; unbounded queue and body-limit bug reported, not touched

P 역순 · 3번째 요청

p1 correct offload, permit and panic handling; real before/after load measurement; only one new test (waiting for a slot), nothing tests that other routes stay responsive

p2 Correct offload + bounded semaphore, panic→500 with message, docs in both READMEs, honest load test; only one test (limit), nothing guards against regressing to in-handler resize

R 정순 · 4번째 요청

p1 correct offload + owned permit + panic→500; unbounded wait is documented and raised with the user; 5 focused tests (responsiveness, waiting, release after failure, validation before queueing, 0→1), confirmed to fail on the old code

p2 Validation before acquire_owned, permit moved into spawn_blocking, JoinError→500, limit configurable (CPU cores, min 1); 5 tests incl. current_thread offload proof, slot release, validation not queued, zero-limit; unbounded wait flagged to user

R 역순 · 3번째 요청

p1 correct implementation, measured before/after; 2 tests, but the limit test only checks that permits hit 0, not that requests actually wait; reports a stash mishap during the work (recovered)

p2 Correct offload + semaphore with panic→500 and a real offload test plus load measurement; but AppState builds Semaphore from raw config (0 from a hand-built Config deadlocks), limit test only yields once, and a git stash mishap during the work

90## Things to know
91
92- **Articles in `media/` are kept in memory.** They are lost when the process stops.
93- **`web/` does not call `api/` or `media/`.** Its `/api/users` route serves hard-coded sample data.
94- **`/landing` has placeholder values.** The product name, the `/signup` link (no such page exists yet), the contact
95 address and the prices are constants at the top of `web/pages/landing.tsx`.
96- **`web/README.md` is the stock Next.js example README.** It does not describe this project.

105class Issues:86class Unfixable(ValueError):
106 """Collects per-row issue codes as boolean masks over the frame's index."""87 """The value is present but cannot be turned into a valid one."""
107
108 def __init__(self, index: pd.Index) -> None:
109 self.index = index
110 self.masks: dict[str, pd.Series] = {}
111
112 def add(self, code: str, mask: pd.Series) -> None:
113 assert code in ISSUE_DESCRIPTIONS, code
114 mask = mask.reindex(self.index, fill_value=False).astype(bool)
115 self.masks[code] = self.masks.get(code, False) | mask
116
117 def column(self) -> pd.Series:
118 codes = pd.Series("", index=self.index)
119 for code, mask in self.masks.items():
120 codes[mask] = codes[mask] + ";" + code
121 return codes.str.lstrip(";")

165def parse_prices(s: pd.Series, products: pd.Series, issues: Issues) -> pd.Series:132def parse_quantity(raw: str) -> int | None:
166 """Parses prices, then repairs them against each product's catalog price.133 if is_missing(raw):
167134 return None
168 Every product in the source sells at a single price, so the most common price per product is taken135 match = QUANTITY.fullmatch(raw.strip())
169 as its catalog price. Missing prices are filled from it, and prices that are exactly 100x it (a136 if not match:
170 dropped decimal point) are corrected.137 raise Unfixable("not a whole number")
171 """138 quantity = int(match.group(1))
172 out = pd.to_numeric(s.str.extract(PRICE_RE, expand=False).str.replace(",", "", regex=False)).astype("Float64")139 if quantity <= 0:
173 issues.add("unit_price_unparseable", s.notna() & out.isna())140 raise Unfixable("quantity must be at least 1")
174141 return quantity
175 catalog = out.groupby(products).agg(lambda p: p.mode().iloc[0] if p.notna().any() else pd.NA)
176 expected = products.map(catalog).astype("Float64")
177
178 x100 = (out - expected * 100).abs() < 0.005
179 issues.add("unit_price_corrected_x100", x100.fillna(False))
180 out = out.mask(x100.fillna(False), expected)
181
182 imputable = s.isna() & expected.notna()
183 issues.add("unit_price_imputed", imputable)
184 issues.add("unit_price_missing", s.isna() & expected.isna())
185 out = out.fillna(expected.where(imputable))
186
187 differs = (out - expected).abs() >= 0.005
188 issues.add("unit_price_differs_from_catalog", differs.fillna(False))
189 return out.round(2)

192def parse_discounts(s: pd.Series, issues: Issues) -> pd.Series:144def parse_price(raw: str) -> float | None:
193 """Accepts fractions (`0.15`) and percentages (`15%`). A blank discount means no discount."""145 if is_missing(raw):
194 percent = s.str.endswith("%", na=False)146 return None
195 numbers = pd.to_numeric(s.str.rstrip("%"), errors="coerce").astype("Float64")147 match = PRICE.fullmatch(raw.strip())
196 out = numbers.mask(percent, numbers / 100)148 if not match:
197 issues.add("discount_unparseable", s.notna() & out.isna())149 raise Unfixable("not a price")
198 out_of_range = (out < 0) | (out >= 1)150 price = float(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
199 issues.add("discount_out_of_range", out_of_range.fillna(False))151 if price <= 0:
200 out = out.mask(out_of_range.fillna(False))152 raise Unfixable("price must be positive")
201 return out.mask(s.isna(), 0.0).round(4)153 return price

204# --- pipeline ---------------------------------------------------------------156def parse_discount(raw: str) -> float | None:
157 """Fraction of the line price taken off; empty means no discount."""
158 text = raw.strip()
159 if is_missing(text):
160 return 0.0
161 if match := PERCENT.fullmatch(text):
162 discount = float(match.group(1)) / 100
163 else:
164 try:
165 discount = float(text)
166 except ValueError:
167 raise Unfixable("not a fraction or percentage") from None
168 if not 0 <= discount < 1:
169 raise Unfixable("discount must be at least 0 and below 100%")
170 return discount

215def clean(raw: pd.DataFrame, today: date) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, dict]:176@dataclass
216 """Returns (clean, rejected, stats). `rejected` holds raw values plus a `reason` column."""177class Result:
217 s = raw.apply(lambda col: col.str.strip())178 clean: pd.DataFrame
218 s = s.mask(s.apply(lambda col: col.str.lower().isin(MISSING)))179 review: pd.DataFrame
219180 issues: pd.DataFrame
220 issues = Issues(s.index)181 rows_read: int
221 df = pd.DataFrame(index=s.index)182 duplicates_removed: int
222 df["order_id"] = s["order_id"]
223 df["order_date"] = parse_dates(s["order_date"], issues, today)
224 df["customer_email"] = parse_emails(s["customer_email"], issues)
225 df["country"] = parse_mapped(s["country"], COUNTRIES, issues, "country_unrecognized")
226 df["product"] = s["product"]
227 df["category"] = parse_mapped(s["category"], CATEGORIES, issues, "category_unrecognized")
228 df["quantity"] = parse_quantities(s["quantity"], issues)
229 df["unit_price"] = parse_prices(s["unit_price"], s["product"], issues)
230 df["discount"] = parse_discounts(s["discount"], issues)
231 df["status"] = parse_mapped(s["status"], STATUSES, issues, "status_unrecognized")
232 df["line_total"] = (df["quantity"] * df["unit_price"] * (1 - df["discount"])).round(2)
233 df["issues"] = issues.column()
234
235 # Duplicates are judged on cleaned values, so `Shipped ` and `shipped` count as the same.
236 duplicate = df.drop(columns="issues").duplicated(keep="first")
237 # Whatever still shares an order_id after removing exact duplicates disagrees on some field.
238 remaining_ids = df.loc[~duplicate, "order_id"]
239 conflicting = ~duplicate & df["order_id"].isin(remaining_ids[remaining_ids.duplicated()])
240 reason = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="string")
241 reason[duplicate] = "duplicate"
242 reason[conflicting] = "conflicting_duplicate"
243
244 kept = reason.isna()
245 clean_df = df[kept].sort_values("order_id", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
246 rejected = raw[~kept].assign(reason=reason[~kept]).sort_values(["order_id", "reason"], kind="stable")
247
248 stats = {
249 "raw_rows": len(raw),
250 "clean_rows": len(clean_df),
251 "rejected": reason.value_counts().to_dict(),
252 # Only count issues on rows that made it into the clean output.
253 "issues": {code: int(mask[kept].sum()) for code, mask in issues.masks.items() if mask[kept].any()},
254 "rows_with_issues": int((clean_df["issues"] != "").sum()),
255 "blank_discount_as_zero": int((s["discount"].isna() & kept).sum()),
256 "normalized": {
257 col: int((raw.loc[kept, col] != df.loc[kept, col].astype("string").fillna("")).sum())
258 for col in ["order_date", "customer_email", "country", "category", "status"]
259 },
260 }
261 return clean_df, rejected, stats

239def _list_prices(prices: pd.Series, products: pd.Series) -> dict[str, float]:

241 known = pd.DataFrame({"product": products, "price": prices}).dropna()
242 return known.groupby("product")["price"].agg(lambda s: s.mode().min()).to_dict()

245def _repair_prices(out: pd.DataFrame, raw: pd.DataFrame, log: IssueLog) -> None:

247 prices = []
248 for line, order_id, product, text, price in zip(
249 raw["source_line"], out["order_id"], out["product"], raw["unit_price"], out["unit_price"]
250 ):

252 if pd.isna(price):
253 price = None # the column holds NaN for empty cells

255 if price is None and is_missing(text): # an unparseable price was already logged as cleared
256 log.add(line, order_id, "unit_price", text, "missing", "no value and no list price")
257 else:
258 if price is None:
259 log.add(line, order_id, "unit_price", text, "filled", f"list price of {product}")
260 price = usual
261 elif round(price, 2) == round(usual * 100, 2):

263 price = usual
264 elif round(price, 2) != round(usual, 2):
265 log.add(line, order_id, "unit_price", text, "kept", f"differs from list price {usual:.2f}")
266 prices.append(price)

270def _check_categories(out: pd.DataFrame, raw: pd.DataFrame, log: IssueLog) -> None:
271 usual = out.dropna(subset=["category"]).groupby("product")["category"].agg(lambda s: s.mode().min())
272 for i, (product, category) in enumerate(zip(out["product"], out["category"])):
273 expected = usual.get(product)
274 if expected is not None and category != expected:
275 line, order_id = raw["source_line"].iat[i], out["order_id"].iat[i]
276 log.add(line, order_id, "category", raw["category"].iat[i], "corrected", f"{product} is {expected}")
277 out.at[out.index[i], "category"] = expected

280def clean(raw: pd.DataFrame, today: date) -> Result:
281 """Cleans `raw`, the export read as text with one `source_line` column added."""
282 log = IssueLog()
283 out = pd.DataFrame(index=raw.index)
284
285 out["order_id"] = raw["order_id"].str.strip().str.upper()
286 for line, original, order_id in zip(raw["source_line"], raw["order_id"], out["order_id"]):
287 if not ORDER_ID.fullmatch(order_id):
288 log.add(line, original, "order_id", original, "kept", "unexpected order id format")
289
290 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "order_date", lambda v: parse_date(v, today))
291 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "customer_email", parse_email)
292 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "country", lambda v: parse_choice(v, COUNTRIES, "country"))
293 out["product"] = raw["product"].map(lambda v: " ".join(v.split()) or None)
294 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "category", lambda v: parse_choice(v, CATEGORIES, "category"))
295 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "quantity", parse_quantity)
296 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "unit_price", parse_price, log_missing=False) # _repair_prices fills or logs
297 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "discount", parse_discount)
298 _clean_column(raw, out, log, "status", lambda v: parse_choice(v, STATUSES, "status"))
299
300 _repair_prices(out, raw, log)
301 _check_categories(out, raw, log)
302
303 out["quantity"] = out["quantity"].astype("Int64")
304 out["unit_price"] = out["unit_price"].astype("Float64").round(2)
305 out["discount"] = out["discount"].astype("Float64").round(4)
306 out["line_total"] = (out["quantity"] * out["unit_price"] * (1 - out["discount"])).round(2)
307 out.insert(0, "source_line", raw["source_line"])
308
309 # Duplicates are judged on cleaned values, so "Shipped " and "shipped" count as the same row.
310 duplicate = out.duplicated(subset=COLUMNS, keep="first")
311 for line, order_id in zip(out.loc[duplicate, "source_line"], out.loc[duplicate, "order_id"]):
312 log.add(line, order_id, "*", "", "removed", "duplicate of an earlier row")
313 out = out[~duplicate]
314
315 # Whatever still shares an order id disagrees on some value; a person has to decide which row is right.
316 conflict = out["order_id"].duplicated(keep=False)
317 for line, order_id in zip(out.loc[conflict, "source_line"], out.loc[conflict, "order_id"]):
318 log.add(line, order_id, "*", "", "set aside", "same order id as another row with different values")
319
320 return Result(
321 clean=out[~conflict].reset_index(drop=True),
322 review=out[conflict].sort_values(["order_id", "source_line"]).reset_index(drop=True),
323 issues=log.frame().reset_index(drop=True),
324 rows_read=len(raw),
325 duplicates_removed=int(duplicate.sum()),
326 )
327

334 raw = raw[COLUMNS].copy()

336 return raw

463def _for_csv(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
464 """Money with two decimals; dates as YYYY-MM-DD."""
465 frame = frame.copy()
466 for column in ("unit_price", "line_total"):
467 frame[column] = frame[column].map(lambda v: "" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:.2f}")
468 frame["discount"] = frame["discount"].map(lambda v: "" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:g}")
469 return frame

88
9- `orders_clean.csv` one row per order, normalised values, plus `line_total`9- orders_clean.csv one row per kept order line, normalized values, empty cells for missing values
10- `orders_review.csv` rows sharing an `order_id` with conflicting values; they are left out of the clean file10- orders_issues.csv every value that was removed, corrected or needs review, with the original text
11- `orders_issues.csv` every change or problem: source line, column, original value, what was done11- report.md what was cleaned, what is still missing, and a sales summary
12- `report.md` what was cleaned and a summary of the clean orders
1312
14Values that cannot be repaired with confidence (an invalid email, a quantity of zero or less, a date in the13Values are only corrected when the right answer is certain from the data itself. Anything else (a negative
15future) are left empty in the clean file rather than guessed; the original is kept in the issues log.14quantity, an email without "@", a date after today) becomes missing and is listed in orders_issues.csv, so the
15original is never lost.

342def _table(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
343 def cell(v) -> str:
344 if isinstance(v, float):
345 return f"{v:,.2f}"
346 return str(v).replace("|", "\\|")
347
348 header = "| " + " | ".join(frame.columns) + " |"
349 rule = "|" + "|".join("---:" if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[c]) else "---" for c in frame.columns) + "|"
350 body = ["| " + " | ".join(cell(v) for v in row) + " |" for row in frame.itertuples(index=False)]
351 return "\n".join([header, rule, *body])

417 "- **corrected**: was wrong in a recognisable way and was replaced.",
418 "- **cleared**: present but invalid, and could not be repaired; left empty.",
419 "- **missing**: empty in the export and left empty.",

421 "",

1"""Clean data/orders.csv and write a summary report.1"""Clean data/orders.csv and write a tidy CSV plus a summary report to out/.
22
3Usage (from data/):3Run from data/:
4
4 uv run python scripts/clean_orders.py5 uv run python scripts/clean_orders.py
56
6Outputs (data/out/):7Outputs:
7 orders_clean.csv rows that survived cleaning, with normalized types8 out/orders_clean.csv one row per valid order, normalized values, `issues` column
8 orders_rejected.csv rows that could not be trusted, with the reason9 listing every fix/flag applied to that row
9 report.md summary of data quality fixes and order metrics10 out/orders_rejected.csv rows that could not be trusted, with original values and reason
11 out/summary.md cleaning stats and revenue summary
12
13Cleaning rules (assumptions are marked):
14 - Dates come in YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD/MM/YYYY and "Month D YYYY". Slash dates
15 with the year last are read as DD/MM/YYYY (assumption: no value in the file has a
16 second component > 12, while many have a first component > 12).
17 Missing dates are kept as blank; dates after today are flagged, not changed.
18 - Country names/codes -> ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (KR, US, GB, DE).
19 - Category spelling/case variants -> Electronics, Furniture, Grocery, Stationery.
20 - Status -> shipped / pending / cancelled / returned.
21 - Quantity "5 pcs" -> 5. Missing, zero or negative quantities are rejected.
22 - Prices: "$", "USD" and thousands separators stripped. Each product has a single
23 catalog price (the most common observed price). Missing prices are filled from the
24 catalog; prices exactly 100x the catalog price are treated as a cents-for-dollars
25 error and divided by 100. Other deviations are kept and flagged.
26 - Discount "15%" and "0.15" both -> 0.15; blank -> 0 (assumption: no discount).
27 - Email lowercased/trimmed; blank, "n/a" or malformed -> blank and flagged.
28 - Exact duplicate rows (after normalization) are collapsed to one. If an order_id
29 still appears more than once with different contents, all its rows are rejected
30 because there is no way to tell which one is correct.

204 raise ValueError(f"{SRC.name} line {line_no}: {e}") from None

206 rows.append(row)

213 if key in seen:

215 seen.add(key)
216 unique_rows.append(row)

218
219 rejected: list[dict] = []

221 kept = []
222 for row in unique_rows:

224 reason = "conflicting_duplicate_order_id"
225 elif row["quantity"] is None:
226 reason = "quantity_missing"
227 elif row["quantity"] <= 0:

229 else:
230 kept.append(row)

236 fix_price(row, catalog)
237 gross = row["quantity"] * row["unit_price"]
238 row["gross_amount"] = round(gross, 2)
239 row["net_amount"] = round(gross * (1 - row["discount"]), 2)
240 row["issues"] = ";".join(row["issues"])

13Cleaning rules (assumptions are marked):10Cleaning rules (every change is recorded in the row's `issues` column):
14 - Dates come in YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD/MM/YYYY and "Month D YYYY". Slash dates11 - order_date: parses YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD/MM/YYYY (day-first) and
15 with the year last are read as DD/MM/YYYY (assumption: no value in the file has a12 "Month D YYYY"; blank or future dates become empty.
16 second component > 12, while many have a first component > 12).13 - customer_email: trimmed and lowercased; blank, "n/a" or malformed become empty.
17 Missing dates are kept as blank; dates after today are flagged, not changed.14 - country / category / status: mapped to one canonical spelling.
18 - Country names/codes -> ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (KR, US, GB, DE).15 - quantity: "pcs" suffix stripped; blank, zero or negative become empty.
19 - Category spelling/case variants -> Electronics, Furniture, Grocery, Stationery.16 - unit_price: "$", "USD" and thousands separators stripped. A price exactly 100x
20 - Status -> shipped / pending / cancelled / returned.17 the product's usual price is divided by 100; a missing price is filled from
21 - Quantity "5 pcs" -> 5. Missing, zero or negative quantities are rejected.18 the usual price. The usual price is the product's most common price.
22 - Prices: "$", "USD" and thousands separators stripped. Each product has a single19 - discount: "15%" and "0.15" both become 0.15; blank means no discount (0).
23 catalog price (the most common observed price). Missing prices are filled from the20 - duplicates: exact duplicate rows are dropped. If an order_id appears again
24 catalog; prices exactly 100x the catalog price are treated as a cents-for-dollars21 with different values, the first row is kept and flagged, and the later rows
25 error and divided by 100. Other deviations are kept and flagged.22 are written to orders_rejected.csv.
26 - Discount "15%" and "0.15" both -> 0.15; blank -> 0 (assumption: no discount).
27 - Email lowercased/trimmed; blank, "n/a" or malformed -> blank and flagged.
28 - Exact duplicate rows (after normalization) are collapsed to one. If an order_id
29 still appears more than once with different contents, all its rows are rejected
30 because there is no way to tell which one is correct.

182def fix_price(row: dict, catalog: dict[str, float]) -> None:
183 expected = catalog[row["product"]]
184 price = row["unit_price"]
185 if price is None:
186 row["unit_price"] = expected
187 row["issues"].append("price_imputed")
188 elif abs(price - expected * 100) < 0.005:
189 row["unit_price"] = expected
190 row["issues"].append("price_scaled_down_x100")
191 elif abs(price - expected) >= 0.005:
192 row["issues"].append("price_off_catalog")

195def clean(raw: pd.DataFrame, today: date) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, dict]:
196 stats: dict = {"input_rows": len(raw)}
197
198 records = raw.to_dict("records")
199 rows = []
200 for line_no, rec in enumerate(records, start=2): # header is line 1
201 try:
202 row = normalize_row(rec, today)
203 except ValueError as e:
204 raise ValueError(f"{SRC.name} line {line_no}: {e}") from None
205 row["_raw"] = rec
206 rows.append(row)
207
208 # Collapse rows that are identical once normalized.
209 seen: set[tuple] = set()
210 unique_rows = []
211 for row in rows:
212 key = tuple(row[c] for c in CLEAN_COLUMNS if c not in ("gross_amount", "net_amount", "issues"))
213 if key in seen:
214 continue
215 seen.add(key)
216 unique_rows.append(row)
217 stats["exact_duplicates_removed"] = len(rows) - len(unique_rows)
218
219 rejected: list[dict] = []
220 id_counts = Counter(r["order_id"] for r in unique_rows)
221 kept = []
222 for row in unique_rows:
223 if id_counts[row["order_id"]] > 1:
224 reason = "conflicting_duplicate_order_id"
225 elif row["quantity"] is None:
226 reason = "quantity_missing"
227 elif row["quantity"] <= 0:
228 reason = "quantity_not_positive"
229 else:
230 kept.append(row)
231 continue
232 rejected.append({**row["_raw"], "reject_reason": reason})
233
234 catalog = build_catalog(unique_rows)
235 for row in kept:
236 fix_price(row, catalog)
237 gross = row["quantity"] * row["unit_price"]
238 row["gross_amount"] = round(gross, 2)
239 row["net_amount"] = round(gross * (1 - row["discount"]), 2)
240 row["issues"] = ";".join(row["issues"])
241
242 clean_df = pd.DataFrame(kept, columns=CLEAN_COLUMNS).sort_values("order_id", ignore_index=True)
243 rejected_df = pd.DataFrame(rejected, columns=[*raw.columns, "reject_reason"]).sort_values(
244 ["reject_reason", "order_id"], ignore_index=True
245 )
246 stats["catalog"] = catalog
247 return clean_df, rejected_df, stats
